name: Boku wa Kimi dake o Mitsumeru Gaiden: Saber Tiger Hen
original_name: 僕はキミだけを見つめる 外伝 サーベルタイガー編
source:
Three mysterious suicides have occurred in Tokyo. The victims belonged to the juvenile gangster group “Sabre-tooth Tiger” led by Takumi, Kazu and Hisa. The group is ordered to reveal the truth behind these violence incidents. What shocking facts will get uncovered?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
东京接连发生了3起神秘自杀事件。死者都是由拓实、和哉与久司率领的少年不良集团“剑齿虎”的成员。集团接到命令，必须查明这一系列暴力事件背后的真相。最终究竟会有怎样骇人听闻的事实浮出水面？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
